events.title: 🛠 The Golden Horde: Survival — Patch 1.0.31
events.summary: 🛠 The Golden Horde: Survival — Patch 1.0.31📜 Patch Notes⚔️ Gameplay & Fixes- Fixed duplicated grass appearing in certain areas of the map. 🌿- Increased the maximum slope angle the player can climb. 🏔- Fixed collision issues with the yurt ladder. 🛖- Fixed headwear display issues when switching to first-person view.- Fixed enemy NPCs getting stuck near the gates of the final fort. 🏰- Fixed flickering of non-interactive beds.- Fixed the warning displayed when the player reaches their maximum carry
